title: Fun gravel ride outside of Barcelona
text: Claudio was awesome! The ride we wanted to go on was closed, but he found an awesome gravel route for us. It was really hot and my buddy had some issues with the elevation and the heat. Claudio was very supportive and made sure we got back in one piece. Epic ride!
author: ryanbranc

title: An enjoyable bike experience
text:
This was a great bike experience with Claudio - he is an excellent guide and the bikes were very good.  He planned the route according to our level of capability and we got to see different areas of Barcelona, as much as we wanted to. 

There are some good bike paths around the city that are away from traffic.  Some areas though we did ride through were on roads with a lot of cars.  We we confident enough with this, but I imagine for some others that could have been a little nerve wracking.

title: A rocky road to the top of Barcelona!
text: Claudio and I did the GRAVELING CYCLING RIDE AROUND BARCELONA ON together 6/2. We climbed a total of 2,971 feet (906 meters) to Tibidabo . . . the site of the church atop the hill viewable from down in Barcelona that was built in 1966, that also has a small amusement park for children there built in 1910, The ride amounted to 28.7 mi (46 km) over 3.5 hours.  The ride is primarily gravel with a few short sections on tarmac. Claudio is an enthusiastic cyclist who has created a terrific company that rents bikes and organizes tours in the Catalonia area.
